# A customer block for C-TWICE, in a book already holding two customers with
# that ID.
#
# GnuCash does not keep a customer's ID unique, so a book can hold two. The
# block states no guid, so its ID is all that says which customer it is.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the block.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_id_two_records_have_is_refused.py.
customer "C-TWICE"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD
